purpose: Predeclared 20-seed robustness comparison of Hybrid NBEM versus NBEM-prop and Logistic Regression

additional_seed_generation.rule: draw until 15 unique values not equal to any original seed

notes: The original five seeds are retained without exclusion.
The 15 additional seeds were deterministically generated before observing Stage-3 outcomes.
All three models use the same outer split for a given dataset and seed.
The first five seed results are reused from already validated final-protocol runs; only the 15 additional seeds require new model fitting.
